note: Name-key → [eur, usd] (non-foil; eur=Cardmarket, usd=TCGplayer). null = no price. Each price is the card's oracle_cards printing's; when that has none, the lowest among the card's default_cards printings on paper, released by the default_cards export's date and not memorabilia. Never a foil or etched price. Keys are normalize_name()-folded with //-faces aliased first-wins. Cards with no price are omitted.
